{{Quote|<nowiki />''Millennium Falcon'' to ''Lillibanca.'' Beacons are in place. You can begin. At Number One, if you please, not Number Twenty.''"<br />"''Acknowledged ''Falcon''. And thanks.|Han Solo, relaying instructions to the communications officer|<ref name="Fury" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''communications officer''' served aboard the [[Confederation]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Lillibanca]]''<ref name="Fury" /> in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'' in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> The [[Communications officer/Legends|officer]] handled communications with the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] via the Confederation communications frequency, in which the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] relayed instructions from [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Falcon'', regarding the ''Lillibanca''{{'s}} role in fighting the [[Fire/Legends|firestorm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|triggered]] by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|forces]]. Solo ordered the crew of the ''Lillibanca'' to target the beacons on the planet sequentially to trigger a controlled burn, starting with beacon Number One, to which the officer responded with acknowledgment and thanks, chuckling as he replied.<ref name="Fury" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer appeared, albeit only by voice, in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[2007]] novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'', the seventh volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Fury" />
